name: d1_bluestein
description: Bluestein chirp-Z any-L: split-complex mixed-radix(2/3/4/5/8) Stockham conv core, minimal smooth pad (10007->20480); large M via Agarwal-Cooley coprime 2D conv (CRT, no inter-axis twiddles; minimal-M split over odd 3^a5^b <= 135: 65537->138240=1024x135, 100003->204800=8192x25) with chirp/CRT-fused entry+exit, per-row kernel-mul-fused fwd+inv, NT-streamed exit scatter; zero-pruned+chirp-fused entry, kernel-mul-fused inverse entry, pruned chirp-fused exit for small M; direct Stockham for smooth L; dense tiny-L floor; fused map chain; all planes in pre-faulted hugepage mmap blocks with L2-way skew (zmm conv kernels, ymm single-pass)
